To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a real-time painterly system can be achieved by rendering point sprites with textures; 2) the parallel nature of the GPU is fully exploited by using local pixel neighborhood information to place the strokes; 3) temporal coherence is achieved by moving the strokes based on optical flow; 4) the user is able to interactively control the style of the painting by adjusting various parameters.
